downloadIntro.zh: 当前版本 v1.57.30，选择与你的电脑匹配的安装包。
downloadIntro.en: The current release is v1.57.30. Choose the installer that matches your computer.

summary.zh: 适用于常见的 Intel 与 AMD 电脑，提供标准安装程序。
summary.en: For common Intel and AMD PCs, delivered as a standard installer.

summary.zh: 适用于 Apple 芯片 Mac，以 DMG 磁盘映像安装。
summary.en: For Apple silicon Macs, delivered as a DMG disk image.

highlights.zh: 复盘历史交易更顺手：选中一笔后按 ↑/↓ 切到上一笔、下一笔；一屏放不下的交易自动切到能看全的周期，可一键切回。
highlights.en: Step through reviewed trades with ↑/↓ once one is selected; a trade too long for the screen switches the chart to a timeframe that shows it whole, with one click back.

highlights.zh: 期货账单的跨月持仓显示真实开仓时间，几个月一起导入或逐月导入都能配上。
highlights.en: Futures statements now give positions held across months their real open time, whether you import months together or one at a time.

highlights.zh: 斐波那契回撤可以向左、向右延长，新画的沿用上次的设置。
highlights.en: Fibonacci retracements can extend left and right; new ones keep your last choice.

highlights.zh: 期货账单导入更准确：夜盘成交不再提前一个交易日，平仓按交易所规则配对开仓。已导入的账单删除后重新导入即可更新。
highlights.en: More accurate futures statements: night-session fills land on the right evening and closes pair with opens by exchange rules. Re-import statements you already imported to apply it.

highlights.zh: AI「测试连接」能直接查出余额不足、API key 无效或模型名写错，报错改成看得懂的提示。
highlights.en: AI Test connection now catches an empty balance, a rejected API key or a wrong model name, and AI errors read in plain language.
